name: Voxtype
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Hyprland integration for the voxtype push-to-talk voice-to-text daemon: theme-aware status, compositor keybindings, and a theme-set hook that repaints the OSD from the applied Omarchy theme.

features: Drives the already-running voxtype.service through its real interface (voxtype record toggle/start/stop/cancel)
Theme-aware status line — colours read from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml at runtime, no baked-in palette
Hyprland keybindings for push-to-talk, cancel and status
theme-set hook (uniquely named voxtype-theme-set) that follows the applied palette
Degrades to the on-disk state file, never crashes, when the daemon is absent
